table.name: mageos_workflow_schedule_state
table.comment: Per-workflow last-run bookkeeping for schedule-type workflows - double-fire guard and watermark

column.name: last_run_at
column.comment: UTC timestamp (minute precision) this workflow last fired - avoids double-fires within the same minute

column.name: last_run_watermark
column.comment: High-water mark (created_at for sales_order, updated_at otherwise) of the last entity dispatched

table.name: mageos_workflow_abandoned_flag
table.comment: Quotes already flagged as abandoned by AbandonedCartDetector - prevents re-detection

column.name: flagged_at
column.comment: When this quote was flagged as abandoned
